setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: The project from chapter 2: channel 1 sends to a MIDI instrument on port 1, MIDI channel 1 (its Device page shows CC Device, MIDI channel CC1, MIDI port OUT 1), and the tempo is 90 BPM (GLOBAL FEEL shows Tempo 90). No pattern has trigs yet, nothing is assigned to a channel and playback is stopped.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Tap Channel (3,8), then Pattern (5,8), choose pattern 1 at (1,1), then tap (1,4), (2,4), (3,4) and (4,4). Row 4 holds steps 1 to 16, so these are the first four steps. PATTERN TRIG PAT01 CH01 shows four bright trigs at the left of row 4. Four neighbouring trigs are a deliberately plain rhythm to hear first; chapter 4 spreads them out.
steps.title: Enter four trigs

steps.caption: Tap Channel (3,8), then tap (1,2), the first pattern slot on row 2, to give channel 1 pattern 1. Mosaic opens MERGE MODES for CH01 because assigning a pattern always shows it, and the tooltip reads Pattern 1 added to ch. 1. Patterns reads 01; ignore the other rows for now.
steps.title: Assign pattern 1

steps.caption: Row 4 of the channel page is the range row: hold (1,4), tap (4,4) and release (1,4) to loop only steps 1 to 4. Steps 1 to 4 stay bright, the rest go dark, and the tooltip reads Channel 1 length changed.
steps.title: Loop four steps

steps.caption: Turn E1 right three detents to Channel tasks, turn E2 to Masks and press K3. NOTE MASKS CH01 lists eight cells (Trig, Note, Vel, Len and Chd1 to Chd4), all X: no mask is set, so the channel has no pitch, velocity or length yet. With no step held, E2 chooses a cell and E3 sets that cell for every step of the channel.
steps.title: Open Masks

steps.caption: Turn E2 to Note and E3 until the channel default reads C3.
steps.title: Set the channel note

steps.caption: Turn E2 to Vel and E3 until the channel default reads 80.
steps.title: Set the channel velocity

steps.caption: Select Note with E2 and turn E3 right until it reads C3 (it starts at X, so about 60 detents), select Vel and turn E3 right to 80 (about 80 detents), then select Len and turn E3 right to 1/2 (8 detents). NOTE MASKS CH01 now lists Note C3, Vel 80 and Len 1/2, the defaults for every step.
steps.title: Give the trigs a pitch, level and length

steps.caption: Tap Play (1,8), listen for two repeats of the four-step loop, then tap Play again. While it plays the screen stays on NOTE MASKS, the Play pad (1,8) is lit and a dim playhead cell moves along row 4. The MIDI strip shows note 60 (C3) at velocity 80 about every 167 ms (1/6 s): four notes per repeat, so you hear a fast stutter rather than a tune. Stop leaves no note sounding. This confirms the whole chain (pattern, channel, masks, output) before you shape the rhythm.
steps.title: Play and stop

steps.caption: Stop playback. The note, velocity and length settings remain C3, 80 and 1/2.
steps.title: Stop and confirm the note setup remains
